answer: The terrace I would price into every new account is Iris scan at a border crossing kiosk: an iris template captured in person at a border kiosk years ago, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since an iris template captured in person at a border kiosk years ago takes calendar time as well as money — and the spiral is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The whisper is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
